confirmed: Both probes reach child readiness and repeatedly fence/recover child policy while the child is observed Paused with desired Running. The gVisor root is observed Unknown with Active policy, waiting for a fresh protected lease. These are control-state observations, not a captured monotonic ready-until history.
reviewed_defect: VerifiedPolicyLease deducts complete exchange latency and can have little remaining usable time. The holder previously waited up to two seconds after a successful exchange regardless of remaining headroom. That wait can outlast its published readiness budget.
change_under_test: Renew when remaining verified duration is at most half of the existing ten-second maximum, or the existing two-second interval elapses. The native lease, one-second publication margin, actual validation, source identities, timeouts, resource limits and fail-closed gates are unchanged.
causal_limit: Insufficient renewal headroom is a source-supported explanation under investigation, not established as the sole cause of the archived child-readiness failure. Supported-host positive public creation and hierarchy remain unaccepted until actual retest.
test_observability: The current harness records bounded changes from one read-only joined metadata query during startup. It does not fabricate acknowledgements, grant leases or change the startup deadline.
